note: Bridge claims schadenfreude belongs to the same club of loanwords kept whole because no native word covered the same ground. Target article states verbatim: 'It sits in the same category as words like [déjà vu] and [senpai], a foreign phrase English adopted wholesale rather than translate, because nothing native said quite the same thing.' This explicitly groups schadenfreude with déjà vu under exactly that reasoning, confirming the bridge claim.
